title: Dragging the edge of the Edge window causes a shadow to appear.
summary: Grab And Move displays a visible strip or mask at the Edge window border during a drag.

judgment.rationale: The scenario requires a discriminating comparison before the failing boundary can be established.
evidence: On 0.99.1 the reporter shows an Edge window and describes narrow strips at both sides while dragging its edge.
A commenter suggested window borders; the reporter asked whether the mask could be removed, comparing AltSnap.

Inspected the supplied screenshot and src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp: current overlay metrics inset window bounds using DWM extended frame bounds and the renderer intentionally draws a translucent fill.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the focused comparison and avoid claiming a cause or covering fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction or supported behavior investigation may be applicable after resolving the identified uncertainty.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate Grab And Move edge mask
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The historical side strips may have involved invisible frame margins; current intentional drag feedback and the reporter’s desired appearance need distinguishing.
plan: Compare the supplied Edge scenario on a current release with native-frame and DPI variations.
Determine whether stray strips extend beyond the visible frame or whether the concern is the intended temporary wash.
Correct a demonstrated geometry or cleanup defect, or separately assess the request for configurable visual feedback.
Add coverage for frame margins, DPI and overlay cleanup.
verification: Overlay geometry matches the visible frame and clears after the drag.
Drag feedback and operation continue to work across DPI and window frame styles.

confidence.rationale: The reported failure boundary and current behavior are not yet established.

Merged PR #48474 tightened the overlay to the visible frame while retaining the white wash. This is relevant but does not establish that the reporter’s requested mask removal is addressed or that current behavior is faulty.
issue_context.analysis: The report and current source do not establish a root cause or a covering fix; distinguish observed behavior from hypothesis.

information_gaps.information: Whether the concern is the transient drag wash itself or stray strips that remain or extend beyond the visible frame on a current release.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes the possible failure boundaries before selecting an implementation.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reporter compares the current release and clarifies the appearance during drag and immediately after release.

actions.label: Approve investigate grab and move edge mask

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and the AltSnap comparison. The Grab And Move overlay was later changed to hug the visible frame while retaining a temporary drag wash. Could you clarify whether, on a current PowerToys release, your concern is the temporary wash itself, or whether extra strips still extend beyond the window or remain after you release the drag? This distinguishes a geometry/cleanup issue from a request to change the visual feedback.
